visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, wavy brown hair is sitting on a grey fabric sofa, smiling at the camera. She is wearing a black sleeveless dress with a white brooch and a black bow at the neck. To her left is a large pink plush rabbit. She holds a black shopping bag with white text and a white flower logo. (2) She presents a black rectangular shoebox wrapped in a white ribbon. She carefully unties the ribbon and opens the box, revealing white tissue paper. Her hands are manicured with white tips. The background remains the same indoor setting with soft, bright lighting. (3) She takes out a black high-heel sandal and holds it close to the camera. The camera focuses on the heel, which is chunky and black with a gold border and a quilted texture on one side. She points to the gold interlocking 'CC' logo on the heel. (4) The scene cuts to a luxury indoor hallway with marble walls and polished floors. The woman is seen walking toward the camera in a montage. The camera alternates between eye-level shots and low-angle shots focusing on her feet and the movement of the shoes on the floor.
